consequences.定義同範圍: 範圍判斷錯咗：一批帳戶或交易冇入系統，下年要追溯補做盡職審查。
consequences.Nexus 同登記: 登記或 nexus 判斷出錯：IRD 發信查詢點解冇登記，老闆召你開會。
consequences.盡職審查: 盡職審查漏洞：審計發現 self-cert 唔合格，要重新聯絡客戶。
consequences.申報資料: 申報資料錯咗：要準備更正報表，並喺合理時間內通知 Commissioner。
consequences.紀錄同行政: 紀錄同通知責任出錯：IRD 要求你解釋點解冇按時通知。
consequences.罰則同執法: 罰則評估錯咗：你嘅風險報告低估咗潛在罰款，董事會要求重做。
consequences.生效同時間表: 時間表判斷錯咗：項目計劃要重排。
consequences.IRD 指引: IRD 指引理解錯咗：XML 被退回，要重新提交。

quotes.text: reporting crypto-asset service provider … means an individual or entity that provides, as a business, a service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers, including by way of acting as a counterparty to, or as an intermediary of, the exchange transactions, or by making available a trading platform

係，只要有香港 nexus 就係

items.title: 以下邊項唔屬 s.50M 嘅 exchange transaction？

items.detail: Exchange transaction 只有兩類：crypto↔fiat 同 crypto↔crypto。用 crypto 付款買貨屬 transfer，如果超過 $390,000 就係 reportable retail payment transaction。

quotes.text: exchange transaction … means— (a) an exchange between relevant crypto-assets and fiat currencies; and (b) an exchange between relevant crypto-assets of the same or different forms

options: 用 USDT 向商戶付款買貨
items.explain: Exchange transaction 只有兩類：crypto↔fiat 同 crypto↔crypto。用 crypto 付款買貨屬 transfer，如果超過 $390,000 就係 reportable retail payment transaction。

items.title: 揾錯處：「HKRCASP 經手嘅 specified electronic money product 一律要按 CARF 申報。」
items.short: 錯：SEMP 被排除喺 relevant crypto-asset 之外
items.detail: Relevant crypto-asset 排除 CBDC、SEMP，同埋 RCASP 合理判定唔可以用嚟支付或投資嘅 crypto-asset。SEMP 同 CBDC 喺 amended CRS 下以 depository account 處理。

quotes.text: s.50M “relevant crypto-asset” excludes “(a) a central bank digital currency; (b) a specified electronic money product; or (c) a crypto-asset that, as adequately determined by a reporting crypto-asset service provider, cannot be used for payment or investment purposes”

options: 錯：SEMP 被排除喺 relevant crypto-asset 之外，2028 年起改由 amended CRS 處理
錯：只有超過 $390,000 先要報
items.explain: Relevant crypto-asset 排除 CBDC、SEMP，同埋 RCASP 合理判定唔可以用嚟支付或投資嘅 crypto-asset。SEMP 同 CBDC 喺 amended CRS 下以 depository account 處理。

items.title: 按 s.50M，fiat currency 包唔包括 CBDC 同 commercial bank money？
items.detail: Fiat currency 嘅定義明確包括 CBDC，亦包括 commercial bank money 同 electronic money products（包括 SEMP）。所以 crypto 換 CBDC 都可以係 exchange transaction。

quotes.text: fiat currency … means the official currency of a jurisdiction … including bank reserves and central bank digital currencies; and (b) includes commercial bank money and electronic money products (including specified electronic money products)

items.explain: Fiat currency 嘅定義明確包括 CBDC，亦包括 commercial bank money 同 electronic money products（包括 SEMP）。所以 crypto 換 CBDC 都可以係 exchange transaction。

items.title: 揾錯處：「NFT 係 non-fungible，所以唔屬 s.50M 嘅 crypto-asset。」
items.short: 錯：定義明確包括 fungible 同 non-fungible tokens
items.detail: NFT 屬 crypto-asset。佢係咪 relevant crypto-asset，就要再睇可唔可以用嚟支付或投資。

quotes.text: s.50M “crypto-asset” (b) includes “(ii) fungible and non-fungible tokens that can be traded or transferred to another individual or entity”

options: 錯：定義明確包括 fungible 同 non-fungible tokens
items.explain: NFT 屬 crypto-asset。佢係咪 relevant crypto-asset，就要再睇可唔可以用嚟支付或投資。

items.title: 一間證監會持牌、做 dealing in securities 嘅法團（屬 financial institution 嘅 investment entity）喺 RCASP 開戶。佢係咪 reportable person？
items.detail: Excluded person 包括上市實體、佢哋嘅 related entity、governmental entity、international organization、central bank，同埋 financial institution（但 para (e) 類 investment entity 除外）。

quotes.text: a financial institution other than an entity described in paragraph (e) of the definition of investment entity in this subsection

options: 係，只要佢係申報稅區居民
唔係：financial institution（para (e) investment entity 除外）屬 excluded person
items.explain: Excluded person 包括上市實體、佢哋嘅 related entity、governmental entity、international organization、central bank，同埋 financial institution（但 para (e) 類 investment entity 除外）。

items.title: 上市公司 A 持有 B 公司 60% 投票權。B 係 RCASP 嘅實體 user。B 係咪 reportable person？
items.short: 唔係：B 係上市實體嘅 related entity
items.detail: s.50M(2)：一方控制另一方就係 related entity；(3)：control 指直接或間接擁有超過 50% 投票權或價值。

quotes.text: an entity that is a related entity of an entity described in paragraph (a)”; s.50M(3): control … means direct or indirect ownership of “more than 50% of the voting rights

options: 唔係：B 係上市實體嘅 related entity，屬 excluded person
只報 B 嘅 controlling persons
items.explain: s.50M(2)：一方控制另一方就係 related entity；(3)：control 指直接或間接擁有超過 50% 投票權或價值。

items.title: 一位律師以 nominee 身份，為客戶 X 喺 RCASP 開戶買賣 crypto。邊個係 crypto-asset user？
items.detail: 代理人、託管人、nominee、簽署人等（FI 或 RCASP 除外）唔當係 user，要 look through 到背後嘅人。

quotes.text: s.50M(6)(a): an individual or entity (other than a financial institution or a reporting crypto-asset service provider), acting … as an agent, custodian, nominee, signatory, investment advisor or intermediary, “is not regarded as a crypto-asset user, and such other individual or entity is regarded as a crypto-asset user”

items.explain: 代理人、託管人、nominee、簽署人等（FI 或 RCASP 除外）唔當係 user，要 look through 到背後嘅人。

items.title: RCASP 為商戶處理一宗 $500,000 嘅 crypto 付款，而按本地 AML 規則要核實付款顧客身份。邊個要當 crypto-asset user？
items.detail: 超過 $390,000 屬 RRPT。如果 AML 規則要求核實顧客身份，顧客亦要當 user（同 reportable user），而且係「in addition to the merchant」。

quotes.text: s.50R(4)(b): the customer of the merchant … must be treated as the crypto-asset user … “and therefore as the reportable user, in addition to the merchant”

items.explain: 超過 $390,000 屬 RRPT。如果 AML 規則要求核實顧客身份，顧客亦要當 user（同 reportable user），而且係「in addition to the merchant」。

items.title: 按 s.50M，transfer 嘅定義有咩關鍵限制？
items.short: 只係 RCASP 根據交易時已知資料
items.detail: Transfer 係「剩餘類別」：如果 RCASP 知道係 exchange，就按 exchange 報。同一 user 喺同一 RCASP 自己戶口之間嘅轉移亦唔計。

quotes.text: s.50M “transfer” … “where, based on the knowledge available to the provider at the time of the transaction, the provider cannot determine that the transaction is an exchange transaction”

options: 所有 crypto 轉移都係 transfer
只係 RCASP 根據交易時已知資料，唔能夠斷定係 exchange transaction 嘅轉移
items.explain: Transfer 係「剩餘類別」：如果 RCASP 知道係 exchange，就按 exchange 報。同一 user 喺同一 RCASP 自己戶口之間嘅轉移亦唔計。

items.title: Reportable retail payment transaction（RRPT）嘅門檻係？
items.detail: $78,000 係 Sch 17C para 5A 低值 e-money 門檻；$7,800,000 係 CRS 高價值個人帳戶門檻。

quotes.text: reportable retail payment transaction … means a transfer of relevant crypto-assets in consideration of goods or services for a value exceeding $390,000

items.explain: $78,000 係 Sch 17C para 5A 低值 e-money 門檻；$7,800,000 係 CRS 高價值個人帳戶門檻。

items.title: 一項規管問題：s.50M 入面嘅 SEMP 定義，同 s.50A（CRS）嘅 SEMP 定義有咩分別？
items.detail: 兩者五項條件相同，但 CARF 版本只係為排除 crypto-asset 而設；CRS 版本涵蓋任何電子貨幣產品，以便 2028 年起當 depository account 處理。

quotes.text: specified electronic money product … means a crypto-asset that— (a) is a digital representation of a single fiat currency …”; amended s.50A(1): “specified electronic money product … means any product that— (a) is a digital representation of a single fiat currency …

options: s.50M 版本係「a crypto-asset that…」；s.50A 版本係「any product that…」，CRS 版本唔限於 crypto-asset
items.explain: 兩者五項條件相同，但 CARF 版本只係為排除 crypto-asset 而設；CRS 版本涵蓋任何電子貨幣產品，以便 2028 年起當 depository account 處理。

items.title: 按 s.50M，邊個係 partner jurisdiction？
items.short: 香港以外已有等同 CARF 法律要求
items.detail: Partner jurisdiction 同 reportable jurisdiction 係兩張唔同嘅名單，都由 Commissioner 公布。截至查閱時 IRD 話名單「in due course」公布。

quotes.text: partner jurisdiction … means any territory outside Hong Kong— (a) that has put in place equivalent legal requirements in relation to CARF; and (b) that is specified in a list published under subsection (13)(a) by the Commissioner

options: 所有同香港簽咗 CDTA 嘅地方
香港以外已有等同 CARF 法律要求，並列入 Commissioner 根據 s.50M(13)(a) 公布名單嘅地方
items.explain: Partner jurisdiction 同 reportable jurisdiction 係兩張唔同嘅名單，都由 Commissioner 公布。截至查閱時 IRD 話名單「in due course」公布。

items.title: 一間 BVI 註冊公司喺中環有 regular place of business，經營 crypto 交易平台，唔係香港稅務居民。佢係咪 HKRCASP？
items.detail: 四個 nexus 獨立適用：稅務居民；香港成立兼有法人地位或報稅責任；喺香港管理；喺香港有 regular place of business。

quotes.text: (d) an individual or entity that has a regular place of business in Hong Kong

options: 唔係，因為唔係香港註冊
items.explain: 四個 nexus 獨立適用：稅務居民；香港成立兼有法人地位或報稅責任；喺香港管理；喺香港有 regular place of business。

items.title: 一間新加坡稅務居民 RCASP 喺香港有分行處理交易（冇其他香港 nexus）。佢喺香港嘅 Part 8B 責任範圍係？
items.short: 只限經香港分行 effectuate 嘅 relevant transacti…
items.detail: Branch nexus（s.50N(2)）只涵蓋經香港分行處理嘅交易。

quotes.text: carry out all the obligations under Part 8B with respect to the relevant transactions that are effectuated through the branch based in Hong Kong

options: 只限經香港分行 effectuate 嘅 relevant transactions
items.explain: Branch nexus（s.50N(2)）只涵蓋經香港分行處理嘅交易。

items.title: 一間香港成立公司（s.50N(1)(b)）同時係 partner jurisdiction 稅務居民，並已喺嗰度遵守 specified requirements。佢喺香港要做咩？
items.short: 可以唔做 s.50P 盡職審查，但仍要登記，收到通知時亦要交簡化報表
items.detail: s.50N(4) 只免除 s.50P 盡職審查，而且條件之一係「has to furnish a return」。s.50O 登記「Despite section 50N(4)…」照樣要做；s.50Q(6) 報表要列明 partner jurisdictions 同符合邊項準則。

quotes.text: is not required to comply with the due diligence requirements under section 50P … if— (a) the specified requirements are complied with by the HKRCASP in a partner jurisdiction by virtue of it being a resident for tax purposes in the partner jurisdiction; and (b) the HKRCASP has to furnish a return under section 50Q(1)

options: 照做全部 s.50P 盡職審查同申報
可以唔做 s.50P 盡職審查，但仍要登記，收到通知時亦要交簡化報表
items.explain: s.50N(4) 只免除 s.50P 盡職審查，而且條件之一係「has to furnish a return」。s.50O 登記「Despite section 50N(4)…」照樣要做；s.50Q(6) 報表要列明 partner jurisdictions 同符合邊項準則。

items.title: 揾錯處：「我哋已經受 s.50N(4) 豁免盡職審查，所以唔使喺香港登記。」
items.detail: 登記責任凌駕所有 cascading 豁免。

quotes.text: Despite section 50N(4), (5), (6), (7), (8) and (9), an HKRCASP must register with the Commissioner in accordance with subsection (2) and section 50V(1).

options: 錯：s.50O(1) 明確話「Despite section 50N(4)…(9)」都要登記
錯：要喺兩個稅區都做盡職審查
items.explain: 登記責任凌駕所有 cascading 豁免。

items.title: RCASP 喺 2027 年 8 月首次符合香港 nexus。最遲幾時要登記？
items.detail: 係首次符合 nexus 嗰個公曆年嘅翌年 1 月 31 日。

quotes.text: on or before 31 January of the calendar year following the calendar year in which the HKRCASP first meets any of the criteria specified in section 50N(1) and (2)

items.explain: 係首次符合 nexus 嗰個公曆年嘅翌年 1 月 31 日。

items.title: 揾錯處：「2027 年 12 月 15 日先首次符合 nexus 嘅 RCASP，要喺 2027 年 12 月 31 日前登記，因為諮詢文件係咁講。」
items.short: 錯：制定咗嘅 s.50O(2) 係翌年 1 月 31 日
items.detail: 諮詢文件建議 12 月 31 日，但最後立法改為翌年 1 月 31 日。以條文為準。

quotes.text: on or before 31 January of the calendar year following the calendar year in which the HKRCASP first meets any of the criteria…

options: 錯：制定咗嘅 s.50O(2) 係翌年 1 月 31 日，即 2028 年 1 月 31 日
items.explain: 諮詢文件建議 12 月 31 日，但最後立法改為翌年 1 月 31 日。以條文為準。

items.title: HKRCASP 用紙本信件向 IRD 登記，Commissioner 仍然想接受。邊條容許？
items.detail: s.50V(1) 要求用電子紀錄經指定系統登記；s.50V(6) 容許 Commissioner 一般或個別情況下接受唔符合要求嘅登記。

quotes.text: The Commissioner may, either generally or in a particular case, accept a registration for the purposes of section 50O(1) despite a requirement under subsection (1) or (5) not being complied with in relation to the registration.

items.explain: s.50V(1) 要求用電子紀錄經指定系統登記；s.50V(6) 容許 Commissioner 一般或個別情況下接受唔符合要求嘅登記。

items.title: RCASP 委託 service provider 代辦登記，但 SP 漏咗。RCASP 話「已經聘人做」。法律上點？
items.short: RCASP 責任唔會因為聘用 SP 而解除，而且聘用 SP 本身唔構成合理辯解

quotes.text: To avoid doubt, even if a service provider has been engaged, the HKRCASP is not relieved from the HKRCASP’s obligation under section 50O(1), 50P(1) or (2) or 50Q(1), as the case requires.

options: RCASP 責任唔會因為聘用 SP 而解除，而且聘用 SP 本身唔構成合理辯解

items.title: 按 s.50N(10)，個人喺邊個情況下屬香港稅務居民？
items.detail: 同 CRS 嘅稅務居民概念一致（IRD FAQ Q16）。法團就睇係咪香港成立，或者通常喺香港管理或控制。

quotes.text: IRD FAQ（AEOI）Q16：180 日／300 日測試；Ord 8 s.50N(10) 同樣採用。

options: 通常居於香港，或者一個課稅年度逗留超過 180 日，或者連續兩個課稅年度（其中一個係有關年度）逗留超過 300 日
items.explain: 同 CRS 嘅稅務居民概念一致（IRD FAQ Q16）。法團就睇係咪香港成立，或者通常喺香港管理或控制。

items.title: 非法團實體（例如 partnership）HKRCASP 嘅 Part 8B 責任落喺邊個身上？
items.short: 代 HKRCASP 同 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人
items.detail: 同 CRS 嘅 s.50E 做法一樣。

quotes.text: this Part applies to a person who acts for the HKRCASP to maintain a relationship with the HKRCASP’s crypto-asset users as if the obligations under this Part were imposed on that person

options: 代 HKRCASP 同 crypto-asset users 維持關係嘅人
items.explain: 同 CRS 嘅 s.50E 做法一樣。

items.title: 一個 HKRCASP 想知 Part 8B 同 Sch 17EA 應該點解釋，例如 OECD CARF FAQ 有冇份量？邊條處理？
items.short: s.50Y：以最能確保同 CARF publications 一致嘅方式應用同…
items.detail: s.50M 嘅 CARF publications 包括 OECD 2025 年 12 月更新嘅 CARF FAQ，以及之後嘅更新。

quotes.text: This Part and Schedule 17EA are to be applied and interpreted in the way that best secures their consistency with the requirements and guidance in the CARF publications.

options: s.50Y：以最能確保同 CARF publications 一致嘅方式應用同解釋
items.explain: s.50M 嘅 CARF publications 包括 OECD 2025 年 12 月更新嘅 CARF FAQ，以及之後嘅更新。

items.title: 邊個可以用憲報公告修訂 Sch 17EA 同 CARF publications 嘅定義？
items.short: Secretary for Financial Services and th…
items.detail: Commissioner 負責公布 reportable／partner jurisdiction 名單（s.50M(13)）；修訂 Sch 17EA 就係 SFST。

quotes.text: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend— (a) the definitions of CARF, CARF publications and Common Reporting Standard in section 50M(1); and (b) Schedule 17EA.

options: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury（s.50W）
items.explain: Commissioner 負責公布 reportable／partner jurisdiction 名單（s.50M(13)）；修訂 Sch 17EA 就係 SFST。

items.title: 揾錯處：「HKRCASP 報上嚟嘅 CARF 資料，IRD 只可以交換俾海外，唔可以用嚟處理香港本地稅務。」
items.short: 錯：s.50X 講明可以用於執行本條例
items.detail: s.50X 用「To avoid doubt」講明。

quotes.text: any information reported in a return furnished under section 50Q(1), or provided in response to a notice given under section 50S(11), may be used for the administration or enforcement of this Ordinance

options: 錯：s.50X 講明可以用於執行本條例
錯：只可以用於刑事調查
items.explain: s.50X 用「To avoid doubt」講明。

items.title: 客戶喺 2026 年 10 月已經同 RCASP 開戶（pre-existing individual user）。RCASP 最遲幾時要取得 self-cert？
items.detail: Pre-existing user 指 2026 年 12 月 31 日或之前建立關係嘅 user。

quotes.text: in the case of a pre-existing individual crypto- asset user—obtain by 1 January 2028 from the user a self-certification

items.explain: Pre-existing user 指 2026 年 12 月 31 日或之前建立關係嘅 user。

items.title: 新個人客戶交咗 self-cert，但同 KYC 資料唔夾（reasonableness test 唔通過）。RCASP 可唔可以先幫佢交易，之後再補？
items.short: 唔可以：要先取得有效 self-cert
items.detail: 新客戶嘅補救一定要喺提供服務之前完成。

quotes.text: … before providing the service of effectuating relevant transactions to the individual crypto-asset user

options: 唔可以：要先取得有效 self-cert，或者合理解釋同文件並保存紀錄，先可以提供交易服務
items.explain: 新客戶嘅補救一定要喺提供服務之前完成。

items.title: Change of circumstances 令 self-cert 失效，RCASP 可以沿用原有身份去到幾時？
items.short: 以下最早者：失效日起 90 個曆日、確認原 self-cert 有效之日、取得…
items.detail: 留意 IRD FAQ Q8 講 CRS 下客戶一般要 30 日內通知變更，同 RCASP 嘅 90 日寬限係兩回事。

quotes.text: until the earliest of the following— (a) the expiry of a period of 90 calendar days … (b) the date on which the validity of the self- certification is confirmed; or (c) the date on which a new valid self-certification is obtained

options: 以下最早者：失效日起 90 個曆日、確認原 self-cert 有效之日、取得新有效 self-cert 之日
items.explain: 留意 IRD FAQ Q8 講 CRS 下客戶一般要 30 日內通知變更，同 RCASP 嘅 90 日寬限係兩回事。

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 話係 A 國居民，後來 RCASP 收到佢 B 國地址。90 日內攞唔到確認或新 self-cert。之後點做？
items.short: 當佢係 A 國同 B 國（因變化而可能成為居民嘅地方）兩邊嘅居民
items.detail: 兩邊都報，唔係二揀一。

quotes.text: must treat the individual crypto-asset user as a resident for tax purposes of— (a) the jurisdiction or jurisdictions in which the user claimed to be a resident … in the original self-certification; and (b) the jurisdiction or jurisdictions in which the user may be a resident for tax purposes as a result of the change of circumstances

options: 當佢只係 A 國居民
當佢係 A 國同 B 國（因變化而可能成為居民嘅地方）兩邊嘅居民
當佢係 B 國居民
items.explain: 兩邊都報，唔係二揀一。

items.title: 揾錯處：「Self-cert 有任何錯誤，即使係打錯字，都一定無效。」
items.short: 錯：inconsequential error 可以靠檔案內有決定性嘅文件補足
items.detail: 條件係 RCASP 檔案內有足夠而具決定性（conclusive）嘅文件。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP may treat a self-certification that contains an inconsequential error as valid if the HKRCASP has sufficient documentation on file … in which case the documentation must be conclusive.

options: 錯：inconsequential error 可以靠檔案內有決定性嘅文件補足
錯：只要客戶口頭確認就得
items.explain: 條件係 RCASP 檔案內有足夠而具決定性（conclusive）嘅文件。

items.title: 實體 user 嘅 self-cert 聲稱佢「唔係任何稅區嘅稅務居民」。RCASP 可以點樣決定佢嘅居民地？
items.short: 可以依據 place of effective management
items.detail: 留意同 CRS 比較：Sch 17D Part 6 只講 principal office；CARF 多咗 place of effective management 選項。

quotes.text: the HKRCASP may rely on the place of effective management, or on the address of the principal office, of the user to determine the user’s jurisdiction of residence

options: 可以依據 place of effective management，或者主要辦事處地址
items.explain: 留意同 CRS 比較：Sch 17D Part 6 只講 principal office；CARF 多咗 place of effective management 選項。

items.title: RCASP 判斷實體 user 嘅 controlling persons，幾時可以直接用 AML/KYC 資料？
items.short: AML/KYC 程序要符合 FATF Recommendations；
items.detail: CRS 2028 年起喺 Sch 17D Part 6 s.5(2) 加入同一規則。

quotes.text: Sch 17EA Part 4 s.4: may rely on AML/KYC information “provided that such procedures are consistent with the FATF Recommendations. (2) If the HKRCASP is not legally required to apply AML/KYC procedures that are consistent with the FATF Recommendations, the HKRCASP must apply substantially similar procedures”

options: AML/KYC 程序要符合 FATF Recommendations；如果法律上唔需要，就要用實質相若嘅程序
items.explain: CRS 2028 年起喺 Sch 17D Part 6 s.5(2) 加入同一規則。

items.title: 揾錯處：「RCASP 可以單憑 AML/KYC 檔案嘅地址，判斷 controlling person 嘅稅務居民地，唔使 self-cert。」
items.short: 錯：CP 嘅居民身份要依 self-cert
items.detail: AML/KYC 用嚟「識別」CP；「居民地」就要 self-cert 加合理性確認。

quotes.text: an HKRCASP must— (a) rely on a self-certification obtained from the user or the controlling person … and (b) confirm the reasonableness of such self- certification

options: 錯：CP 嘅居民身份要依 self-cert，再用 AML/KYC 資料做 reasonableness check
錯：一定要取得稅務局證明
items.explain: AML/KYC 用嚟「識別」CP；「居民地」就要 self-cert 加合理性確認。

items.title: 以下邊項唔係個人 self-cert 有效嘅必要內容（Sch 17EA Part 5 s.2）？
items.detail: 必要內容：姓名、住址、居民地、每個申報稅區嘅 TIN、出生日期；仲要簽署或以其他方式確認，並註明日期。

quotes.text: (i) first and last name; (ii) residential address; (iii) jurisdiction or jurisdictions of residence; (iv) … the TIN with respect to each reportable jurisdiction …; and (v) date of birth

items.explain: 必要內容：姓名、住址、居民地、每個申報稅區嘅 TIN、出生日期；仲要簽署或以其他方式確認，並註明日期。

items.title: 揾錯處：「客戶 1 月 10 日交嘅 self-cert 寫明日期係 1 月 20 日，冇問題。」
items.short: 錯：日期唔可以遲過收到嘅日期
items.detail: Self-cert 要「dated」，而且日期唔可以遲過 RCASP 收到嘅日期。

quotes.text: is dated and the date is not later than the date of receipt

options: 錯：日期唔可以遲過收到嘅日期
items.explain: Self-cert 要「dated」，而且日期唔可以遲過 RCASP 收到嘅日期。

items.title: 客戶 self-cert 冇填 TIN；OECD 資料顯示嗰個申報稅區會向所有居民發 TIN。RCASP 可唔可以接受？
items.short: 唔可以：屬 RCASP 知道或有理由知道 self-cert 不可靠
items.detail: 2028 年起 CRS 嘅 Sch 17D Part 7 s.2 亦加入同一情況。

quotes.text: the self-certification does not contain a TIN and the information disseminated by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development indicates that the reportable jurisdiction issues TINs to all residents for tax purposes

options: 唔可以：屬 RCASP 知道或有理由知道 self-cert 不可靠
items.explain: 2028 年起 CRS 嘅 Sch 17D Part 7 s.2 亦加入同一情況。

items.title: 客戶聲稱只係某個有潛在高風險 CBI/RBI 計劃嘅稅區居民。RCASP 有疑問，但冇進一步查問。可唔可以依賴 self-cert？
items.short: 唔可以，除非已經採取進一步措施（例如追問、核實有支持文件嘅回覆）
items.detail: 呢個係 2023 年 OECD 更新後加入嘅明示「reason to know」情況。

quotes.text: … claiming residence in a jurisdiction offering a potentially high-risk citizenship or residence by investment scheme, and the HKRCASP has not taken further measures to ascertain the jurisdiction of residence …

options: 唔可以，除非已經採取進一步措施（例如追問、核實有支持文件嘅回覆）
items.explain: 呢個係 2023 年 OECD 更新後加入嘅明示「reason to know」情況。

items.title: 一間銀行同時係 CRS RFI 同 HKRCASP。佢可唔可以借用 CRS 已完成嘅盡職審查？
items.short: 可以：個人 user 借用 Sch 17D Part 4
items.detail: 另外，為其他稅務目的收集嘅 self-cert，只要符合 Sch 17EA Part 5 都可以用（Part 2 s.4）。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP that is also a reporting financial institution for the purposes of the Common Reporting Standard may rely on the due diligence procedures completed pursuant to Part 4 of Schedule 17D for the purposes of performing the due diligence procedures pursuant to Part 3 of this Schedule.

options: 可以：個人 user 借用 Sch 17D Part 4，實體 user 借用 Sch 17D Part 6
items.explain: 另外，為其他稅務目的收集嘅 self-cert，只要符合 Sch 17EA Part 5 都可以用（Part 2 s.4）。

items.title: 雙重稅務居民 crypto 用戶可唔可以用稅務協定嘅 tiebreaker 只申報一個居民地？
items.short: 唔可以，要申報全部居民地
items.detail: CRS 2028 年起都有同一規則（Sch 17D Part 7 s.2B）。

quotes.text: (a) cannot rely on the tiebreaker rules contained in any applicable tax arrangements …; and (b) must declare all of the user’s or controlling person’s jurisdictions of residence

options: 唔可以，要申報全部居民地
items.explain: CRS 2028 年起都有同一規則（Sch 17D Part 7 s.2B）。

items.title: 實體 user 嘅 self-cert 話佢係 reportable jurisdiction 居民，但 RCASP 根據公開資料合理判定佢係上市公司。點處理？
items.short: 可以根據 self-cert、手上資料或公開資料
items.detail: Excluded person 唔係 reportable person。

quotes.text: must treat the user as a reportable user unless the HKRCASP reasonably determines, on the basis of the self- certification or information that is in the HKRCASP’s possession or is publicly available, that the user is an excluded person

options: 可以根據 self-cert、手上資料或公開資料，合理判定佢係 excluded person
要向 IRD 申請豁免
items.explain: Excluded person 唔係 reportable person。

items.title: RCASP 喺咩情況下唔使判斷實體 user 有冇 reportable controlling persons？
items.detail: 同 CRS 嘅 active NFE 概念相似，但 CARF 用「active entity」。

quotes.text: … or an entity (other than an excluded person or an active entity) that has one or more controlling persons who are reportable persons

options: user 係 excluded person，或者 RCASP 根據 self-cert 判定 user 係 active entity
items.explain: 同 CRS 嘅 active NFE 概念相似，但 CARF 用「active entity」。

items.title: RCASP 修訂咗 AML/KYC 程序，新收集嘅資料同客戶 self-cert 唔一致。法律後果？
items.short: RCASP 知道或有理由知道 self-cert 不可靠
items.detail: Sch 17EA Part 6 s.2(c) 同 s.4 一齊用。

quotes.text: there is an amendment to the applicable AML/KYC procedures and the additional information obtained under the amended AML/KYC procedures is inconsistent with the claims made by the user or controlling person in a self-certification

options: RCASP 知道或有理由知道 self-cert 不可靠，而且要用新資料判斷有冇 change of circumstances
items.explain: Sch 17EA Part 6 s.2(c) 同 s.4 一齊用。

items.title: HKRCASP 想對非申報稅區居民嘅 user 都用同一套盡職審查程序，簡化系統。邊條容許？
items.detail: 可以選擇對所有 user 應用。

quotes.text: s.50P(3)：HKRCASP 可以將盡職審查程序應用於唔係 reportable user 嘅 crypto-asset users（Ord 8 s.50P）。

items.explain: 可以選擇對所有 user 應用。

items.title: s.50R(3)(d) 嘅交易資料點樣呈報？
items.short: 按每類 relevant crypto-asset 匯總
items.detail: CARF 報交易流量，唔係結餘；呢點同 CRS 唔同。

quotes.text: for each type of the relevant crypto-asset with respect to which the HKRCASP concerned has effectuated relevant transactions …

options: 按每類 relevant crypto-asset 匯總（金額、單位數目、交易數目）
items.explain: CARF 報交易流量，唔係結餘；呢點同 CRS 唔同。

items.title: 客戶喺 RCASP 託管錢包轉 2 BTC 去一個 RCASP 唔知屬於任何 VASP 或 FI 嘅錢包地址。要報咩？
items.short: 另外報呢類轉移嘅 aggregate fair market value 同單…
items.detail: 呢個係 OECD 為追蹤 unhosted wallet 而設嘅欄位。

quotes.text: … in respect of transfers by the reportable user effectuated by the HKRCASP to wallet addresses not known by the HKRCASP to be associated with a virtual asset service provider or financial institution (both as defined in FATF Recommendations)

options: 另外報呢類轉移嘅 aggregate fair market value 同單位數目
items.explain: 呢個係 OECD 為追蹤 unhosted wallet 而設嘅欄位。

items.title: HKRCASP 想用自己嘅財政年度（4 月至翌年 3 月）計交易匯總。邊條容許、有咩代價？
items.detail: 選擇係不可撤回嘅。

quotes.text: during the period specified under section 50Q(2) or another period of 12 months that the HKRCASP irrevocably elects

options: s.50R(3)(d)：可以 irrevocably elect 另一個 12 個月期間
items.explain: 選擇係不可撤回嘅。

items.title: 實體 user 有一個 reportable controlling person。報表要包括 CP 嘅咩資料？
items.short: 姓名、地址、居民地、TIN、出生日期同地點，以及成為 CP 嘅角色
items.detail: 「角色」欄位同 2028 年起 CRS s.50F(2)(c)(iii) 一致。

quotes.text: (ii) the name, address, jurisdiction of residence, TIN and the date and place of birth of each reportable person; and (iii) the role by virtue of which each reportable person is a controlling person of the entity

options: 姓名、地址、居民地、TIN、出生日期同地點，以及成為 CP 嘅角色
items.explain: 「角色」欄位同 2028 年起 CRS s.50F(2)(c)(iii) 一致。

items.title: HKRCASP 全年冇任何 identified crypto-asset user。佢收到 s.50Q(2) 通知，要點交？
items.short: 照交報表，內容係 HKRCASP 名稱、地址、識別號碼，加一句冇維持關係或冇為…
items.detail: 即係 nil-type return。

quotes.text: (a) the name, address and identifying number (if any) of the HKRCASP; and (b) a statement of the fact that the HKRCASP does not maintain a relationship with, or does not effectuate any relevant transaction for or on behalf of, the identified crypto-asset user

options: 照交報表，內容係 HKRCASP 名稱、地址、識別號碼，加一句冇維持關係或冇為其進行交易嘅聲明
items.explain: 即係 nil-type return。

items.title: 揾錯處：「X 國喺 2028 年 3 月先列入 reportable jurisdiction，HKRCASP 都要報 2027 年全年 X 國 user 嘅交易。」
items.short: 錯：specified information period 唔可以涵蓋該稅區…
items.detail: s.50Q(3) 防止追溯。

quotes.text: However, the specified information period for a reportable jurisdiction may not cover any period that is earlier than the date on which the jurisdiction becomes a reportable jurisdiction.

options: 錯：specified information period 唔可以涵蓋該稅區成為 reportable jurisdiction 之前嘅期間
items.explain: s.50Q(3) 防止追溯。

items.title: s.50Q(2) 通知指定嘅申報期一般係？
items.short: 發通知嗰年嘅上一個公曆年，或者 Commissioner 認為適當嘅其他期間
items.detail: 同 CRS 嘅公曆年申報一致。

quotes.text: (a) the calendar year preceding the year in which the notice is given; or (b) such other period as the Commissioner considers appropriate

options: 課稅年度（4 月至翌年 3 月）
發通知嗰年嘅上一個公曆年，或者 Commissioner 認為適當嘅其他期間
任何 RCASP 揀嘅期間
items.explain: 同 CRS 嘅公曆年申報一致。

items.title: HKRCASP 報表相關紀錄要保存幾耐？
items.detail: 同 Ord 4 修訂後嘅 CRS s.50D(2) 一致。

quotes.text: the specified record keeping period is a period of 6 years immediately after the date by which the return is required to be furnished under section 50Q(1)

items.explain: 同 Ord 4 修訂後嘅 CRS s.50D(2) 一致。

items.title: HKRCASP 搬咗辦公室，要幾時通知 Commissioner 新地址？
items.detail: 停止或恢復做 HKRCASP 都係 1 個月內通知（s.50S(4)、(5)）。

quotes.text: If an HKRCASP changes the address, the HKRCASP must notify the Commissioner of the new address within 1 month…

items.explain: 停止或恢復做 HKRCASP 都係 1 個月內通知（s.50S(4)、(5)）。

items.title: 一間公司解散，解散前 6 年內曾經係 HKRCASP。邊個要做咩？
items.detail: 違反可觸發 s.80U 刑責，或者 s.82G 金錢罰則。

quotes.text: every specified officer, or the designated officer (if any), of the entity must— (a) give a notice of the dissolution to the Commissioner within 1 month after the dissolution; and (b) ensure that the requirement under subsection (1) is complied with despite the dissolution

options: 每位 specified officer（或 designated officer）要喺解散後 1 個月內通知，並確保紀錄繼續保存
清盤人 6 個月內通知
items.explain: 違反可觸發 s.80U 刑責，或者 s.82G 金錢罰則。

items.title: Specified officers 可唔可以揀一個人做 designated officer，統一處理解散後責任？
items.short: 可以，但要全部 specified officers 書面同意
items.detail: Designated officer 要簽署表示同意，並列出指定詳情（s.50S(14)）。

quotes.text: on agreement evidenced in writing by all specified officers of an entity …, the specified officers may designate a person mentioned in subsection (16) to be a designated officer

options: 可以，但要全部 specified officers 書面同意
items.explain: Designated officer 要簽署表示同意，並列出指定詳情（s.50S(14)）。

items.title: HKRCASP 可以委託 service provider 處理邊啲責任？
items.detail: 可以委託，但責任唔會轉移（s.50U(2)）。

quotes.text: (a) section 50O(1); (b) section 50P(1); (c) section 50P(2); (d) section 50Q(1)

items.explain: 可以委託，但責任唔會轉移（s.50U(2)）。

items.title: HKRCASP 冇合理辯解冇做 s.50P 盡職審查，涉及 50 個 users 同 controlling persons。法例下最高罰款係？

quotes.text: (a) a fine at level 3; or (b) a fine of $1,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher

items.title: HKRCASP 罔顧實情（reckless）提交 misleading 報表，涉及 3 個 users。罰則係？
items.detail: s.80R(9) 涵蓋知情、罔顧，或者冇合理理由相信資料真確。第 4 級嘅金額本頁未從官方來源核實。

quotes.text: (a) a fine at level 4; or (b) a fine of $5,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher

options: 第 3 級或 $3,000，以較高者為準
items.explain: s.80R(9) 涵蓋知情、罔顧，或者冇合理理由相信資料真確。第 4 級嘅金額本頁未從官方來源核實。

items.title: HKRCASP 意圖詐騙提供虛假資料（s.80R(13)），經公訴程序定罪嘅最高刑罰係？
items.short: 第 6 級或 $20,000 × 涉及人數（以較高者為準），加監禁 3 年
items.detail: 循簡易程序就係第 5 級或 $10,000 × 人數，加 6 個月。

quotes.text: on conviction on indictment— (i) … (A) a fine at level 6; or (B) a fine of $20,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons …, whichever is the higher; and (ii) to imprisonment for 3 years

options: 第 5 級罰款加 6 個月監禁
第 6 級或 $20,000 × 涉及人數（以較高者為準），加監禁 3 年
items.explain: 循簡易程序就係第 5 級或 $10,000 × 人數，加 6 個月。

items.title: HKRCASP 因為唔登記被定罪後仍然冇登記。持續罰款係？
items.detail: 適用於 s.50O(1)、s.50Q(1) 同 s.51B(1AAAD)、51BB(6) 通知。

quotes.text: … the HKRCASP is liable to a further fine of $500 for every day or part of a day during which the offence continues after conviction

items.explain: 適用於 s.50O(1)、s.50Q(1) 同 s.51B(1AAAD)、51BB(6) 通知。

items.title: HKRCASP 交表之後發現資料錯咗，但冇喺合理時間內通知 Commissioner。後果？
items.detail: 發現錯誤之後通知亦係一項獨立責任。

quotes.text: … (a) discovers that the return, information or statement is misleading, false or inaccurate; and (b) without reasonable excuse, fails to notify the Commissioner of the discovery within a reasonable time

options: 屬 s.80R(11) 罪行：第 3 級或 $1,000 × 涉及人數，以較高者為準
items.explain: 發現錯誤之後通知亦係一項獨立責任。

items.title: IRD 想對漏咗登記嘅 HKRCASP 施加金錢罰則代替檢控。邊條係法律依據？
items.detail: s.82C 係 Ord 4 為 CRS RFI 加嘅對應條文；s.80B 係 CRS RFI 刑事罰則。

quotes.text: s.82E(1)(a)(i): if an HKRCASP, without reasonable excuse, “fails to comply with section 50O(1)” … “the HKRCASP is liable to be subjected to a financial penalty assessed under this section”

items.explain: s.82C 係 Ord 4 為 CRS RFI 加嘅對應條文；s.80B 係 CRS RFI 刑事罰則。

items.title: s.82E 金錢罰則嘅上限係？
items.short: 唔可以超過如果被 s.80R 定罪要付嘅罰款
items.detail: 而且只可以喺未就相同事實提出檢控嘅情況下使用。

quotes.text: … not exceeding the amount that the HKRCASP would have been liable to pay as a fine on conviction under section 80R

options: 唔可以超過如果被 s.80R 定罪要付嘅罰款
items.explain: 而且只可以喺未就相同事實提出檢控嘅情況下使用。

items.title: 揾錯處：「IRD 嘅 AEOI 組長（assessor）可以自行評定 s.82E 金錢罰則。」
items.short: 錯：只可以由 Commissioner 本人或副局長本人評定
items.detail: 稱為 specified authority。

quotes.text: An assessment of financial penalty may be made only by the Commissioner personally or a deputy commissioner personally (each is referred to as the specified authority).

options: 錯：只可以由 Commissioner 本人或副局長本人評定
items.explain: 稱為 specified authority。

items.title: 評定 s.82E 金錢罰則之前，意向通知俾 HKRCASP 申述嘅限期最少有幾耐？
items.short: 指定日期唔可以喺發出通知後 21 日內
items.detail: Specified authority 要考慮申述同證據。

quotes.text: specify the date, which must not be within 21 days after the notice is given, by which the representation and evidence … must be received

options: 指定日期唔可以喺發出通知後 21 日內
items.explain: Specified authority 要考慮申述同證據。

items.title: 揾錯處：「IRD 已就漏報作出 s.82E 評定，之後仍可以就同一行為根據 s.80R 檢控。」
items.short: 錯：已評定就唔可以就同一作為或不作為被控
items.detail: 兩條路只可以揀一條。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP in respect of which an assessment is made under this section for an act or omission is not liable to be charged with an offence under section 80R for the same act or omission.

options: 錯：已評定就唔可以就同一作為或不作為被控
items.explain: 兩條路只可以揀一條。

items.title: 唔服 s.82E 評定，點上訴？
items.short: 向 Board of Review 上訴
items.detail: 金錢罰則按稅款方式追收（s.82E(10)）。

quotes.text: the HKRCASP may within— (a) 1 month after the notice of assessment is given to the HKRCASP; or (b) the period as extended under subsection (3), lodge … an appeal against the assessment by giving a notice of appeal to the Board of Review

options: 向原訟法庭上訴，限期 14 日
向 Board of Review 上訴，限期係評定通知發出後 1 個月（可延長）
items.explain: 金錢罰則按稅款方式追收（s.82E(10)）。

items.title: 客戶喺 CARF self-cert 入面明知而作虛假陳述，罰則係？
items.detail: CRS 嘅對應條文係 s.80(2E)/(2F)。

quotes.text: A person who commits an offence under subsection (2ZD) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 3.

items.explain: CRS 嘅對應條文係 s.80(2E)/(2F)。

items.title: HKRCASP 唔遵守 s.80R(3) 嘅法庭命令（例如命令佢登記），罰則係？

quotes.text: An HKRCASP commits an offence if the HKRCASP does not comply with an order of the court under subsection (3), and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4.

items.title: HKRCASP 冇合理辯解，提交嘅報表喺重要事項上不正確或不完整（冇欺詐意圖），涉及 8 個 users。罰則係？
items.short: 第 3 級或 $8,000，以較高者為準
items.detail: 「Incorrect or incomplete」屬 s.80R(7)，同 s.80R(9) 嘅「misleading, false or inaccurate」加知情或罔顧要分開。

quotes.text: (a) a fine at level 3; or (b) a fine of $1,000 multiplied by the number of the crypto-asset users and the controlling persons of the users who are the subjects of the offence, whichever is the higher

options: 第 3 級或 $8,000，以較高者為準
items.explain: 「Incorrect or incomplete」屬 s.80R(7)，同 s.80R(9) 嘅「misleading, false or inaccurate」加知情或罔顧要分開。

items.title: 2028 年 1 月 1 日起，depository account 新增邊兩類？
items.short: 代表客戶全部 SEMP 嘅帳戶或名義帳戶，同持有 CBDC 嘅帳戶

quotes.text: (d) an account or notional account that represents all specified electronic money products held for the benefit of a customer; and (e) an account that holds one or more central bank digital currencies for the benefit of a customer

options: 代表客戶全部 SEMP 嘅帳戶或名義帳戶，同持有 CBDC 嘅帳戶

items.title: 一個電子支付產品純粹為按客戶指示轉賬而設，正常業務下資金收到指示後 20 日內轉出。佢係咪 SEMP？
items.short: 唔係：屬純為方便轉賬而設嘅產品
items.detail: 60 日係分界。

quotes.text: a specified electronic money product does not include a product created for the sole purpose of facilitating the transfer of funds from a customer to another person pursuant to the instructions of the customer

options: 唔係：屬純為方便轉賬而設嘅產品
items.explain: 60 日係分界。

items.title: 同一產品，但正常業務下資金收到指示後通常持有 75 日先轉出。仲可唔可以話係「純為轉賬」？
items.short: 唔可以：持有超過 60 日就唔當係純為轉賬
items.detail: 冇收到指示嘅情況，就由收到資金起計 60 日。

quotes.text: amended s.50A(16AAB)(b): a product is not regarded as being created for the sole purpose … “(i) if instructions to facilitate the transfer are received—the funds connected with the product are held longer than 60 days after the receipt of the instructions”

options: 唔可以：持有超過 60 日就唔當係純為轉賬
items.explain: 冇收到指示嘅情況，就由收到資金起計 60 日。

items.title: 一個客戶喺同一 RFI 持有 3 款 SEMP。點樣計帳戶？
items.short: 合併當作該客戶一個 depository account，價值要加埋計
items.detail: 同 Sch 17C para 5A 嘅低值豁免（$78,000）一齊理解。

quotes.text: (a) all specified electronic money products held by an entity for the benefit of a customer are regarded together as a depository account of that customer; (b) … must aggregate the value of all specified electronic money products

options: 合併當作該客戶一個 depository account，價值要加埋計
items.explain: 同 Sch 17C para 5A 嘅低值豁免（$78,000）一齊理解。

items.title: RFI 以 crypto 形式代客戶持有 tokenised bond，保管 private keys，並可以代客戶轉讓。2028 年起屬咩帳戶？
items.detail: 兩個條件都要符合：保管或管理控制工具，同埋有能力代客戶管理、買賣或轉讓。

quotes.text: if one or more financial assets are issued in the form of a crypto-asset, an arrangement … to the extent that the institution— (i) safekeeps or administers the instruments enabling control over the assets; and (ii) has the ability to manage, trade or transfer to third parties, those assets

items.explain: 兩個條件都要符合：保管或管理控制工具，同埋有能力代客戶管理、買賣或轉讓。

items.title: 揾錯處：「一間 RCASP 為客戶提供 exchange 服務，所以佢自動屬 investment entity（para (d)(iii)），要做 CRS RFI。」
items.detail: 新 s.50A(13)(c) 防止 CARF 同 CRS 雙重覆蓋。

quotes.text: provision of service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers is not regarded as otherwise investing, administering, or managing financial assets, money, or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entity or individual

options: 錯：提供 effectuating exchange transactions 服務唔當作 otherwise investing, administering, or managing
錯：RCASP 一律係 depository institution
items.explain: 新 s.50A(13)(c) 防止 CARF 同 CRS 雙重覆蓋。

items.title: 2028 年起 passive income 新增咩項目？
items.short: 源自 relevant crypto-assets 嘅收入
items.detail: 直接影響 active／passive NFE 嘅分類。

quotes.text: (ea) income derived from relevant crypto-assets;

options: 源自 relevant crypto-assets 嘅收入
items.explain: 直接影響 active／passive NFE 嘅分類。

items.title: 一間 NFE 經常以 dealer 身份買賣 relevant crypto-assets。佢日常業務交易收入算唔算 passive income？

quotes.text: amended s.50A(14B): passive income “does not include, in the case of an NFE that regularly acts as a dealer in financial assets or relevant crypto-assets, any income from a transaction entered into in the ordinary course of the NFE’s business as such a dealer”

items.title: 政府實體為一般公眾（非 FI）維持 CBDC 帳戶。就呢項活動，佢仲係 non-reporting FI 嗎？
items.short: 唔係：維持 CBDC 帳戶俾非 FI 等人士嘅活動被剔出 NRFI 地位
items.detail: International organization、central bank 同 HKMA 都一樣（Sch 17C Part 2 s.1 至 4）。

quotes.text: an activity of maintaining central bank digital currencies for account holders which are not financial institutions, governmental entities, international organizations, central banks or the Hong Kong Monetary Authority

options: 唔係：維持 CBDC 帳戶俾非 FI 等人士嘅活動被剔出 NRFI 地位
items.explain: International organization、central bank 同 HKMA 都一樣（Sch 17C Part 2 s.1 至 4）。

items.title: 新 qualified non-profit entity（Sch 17C Part 2 s.14）成為 NRFI 嘅前提係？
items.short: 係香港居民，並取得 Commissioner 確認符合所有條件
items.detail: 條件包括：只為宗教、慈善等目的成立運作、香港免稅、冇股東享有收入或資產、解散時資產歸政府或同類實體。

quotes.text: An entity is a non-reporting financial institution if it is resident in Hong Kong and has obtained a confirmation by the Commissioner that it meets all of the following conditions

options: 自動適用於所有慈善團體
係香港居民，並取得 Commissioner 確認符合所有條件
items.explain: 條件包括：只為宗教、慈善等目的成立運作、香港免稅、冇股東享有收入或資產、解散時資產歸政府或同類實體。

items.title: 公司成立用嘅 capital contribution 帳戶已經開咗 14 個月，仲未轉名。佢係咪 excluded account？
items.short: 唔係：條件之一係帳戶開立唔超過 12 個月
items.detail: 其他條件包括：資金凍結至取得獨立確認、失敗時只退還出資人。

quotes.text: the account was not established more than 12 months ago

options: 唔係：條件之一係帳戶開立唔超過 12 個月
items.explain: 其他條件包括：資金凍結至取得獨立確認、失敗時只退還出資人。

items.title: 客戶 SEMP 嘅 90 日滾動平均結餘，年內最高去到 $80,000。佢嘅 SEMP 帳戶係咪 excluded account？
items.detail: 只要年內任何一日超過 $78,000，就唔符合豁免。

quotes.text: the rolling average 90-day end-of-day aggregate account balance or value during any period of 90 consecutive days did not exceed $78,000 at any day during the calendar year

items.explain: 只要年內任何一日超過 $78,000，就唔符合豁免。

items.title: 2028 年起，cash value insurance contract 嘅 account holder 包括邊個？
items.short: 有權提取現金價值或更改受益人嘅人，除非已最終、完全、不可撤回地放棄兩項權利

quotes.text: an individual or entity that has the right to access the cash value, or the right to change the beneficiaries, of the contract is regarded as an account holder … unless the individual or entity has finally, fully and irrevocably renounced both

options: 有權提取現金價值或更改受益人嘅人，除非已最終、完全、不可撤回地放棄兩項權利

items.title: 揾錯處：「退休基金分成多個 sub-funds 獨立運作，5% 單一受益人測試都係睇整個基金。」
items.short: 錯：sub-funds 實際上作獨立退休產品運作時
items.detail: 新 Sch 17C Part 2 s.6(2)。

quotes.text: the test of whether a single beneficiary has a right to more than 5% of the fund’s assets must be applied at the level of each sub-fund

options: 錯：sub-funds 實際上作獨立退休產品運作時，要逐個 sub-fund 測試
items.explain: 新 Sch 17C Part 2 s.6(2)。

items.title: 揾錯處：「Reportable person 定義 para (b) 只排除上市『corporation』嘅 related corporation，2028 年後都係咁。」
items.short: 錯：2028 年起改為「entity」，涵蓋範圍更闊

quotes.text: Ord 8 s.19(21): Section 50A(1), definition of reportable person, paragraph (b)(ii)— Repeal “a corporation that is a related entity of a corporation” Substitute “an entity that is a related entity of an entity”.

options: 錯：2028 年起改為「entity」，涵蓋範圍更闊

items.title: 2028 年起，個人 reportable person 要額外報咩？
items.detail: 實體同 controlling person 都一樣要報。

quotes.text: (i) the name, address, jurisdiction of residence, TIN and the date and place of birth of the individual; and (ii) whether the individual has provided a valid self- certification

items.explain: 實體同 controlling person 都一樣要報。

items.title: 2028 年起聯名帳戶要報咩新資料？
items.short: 係咪聯名帳戶，同埋帳戶持有人數目
items.detail: IRD FAQ Q12：聯名帳戶照全數報，唔分攤；新欄位幫收件稅局理解。

items.title: 一個喺 2027 年 12 月 31 日已存在嘅 reportable 帳戶，controlling person 嘅角色唔喺 RFI 嘅電子可搜尋資料入面。2028 年報告期要唔要報角色？

options: 唔使：報告期喺 2029 年 12 月 31 日或之前結束，而資料唔喺電子可搜尋資料

items.title: 一間銀行同時係 RFI 同 RCASP。客戶出售 crypto 形式嘅金融資產，gross proceeds 已喺 CARF 報。CRS 下點處理？
items.short: CRS 下唔使報，除非 RFI 選擇就某組清楚界定嘅帳戶照報
items.detail: 防止重複申報（IRD Bill 頁亦有說明）。

quotes.text: unless a reporting financial institution elects otherwise with respect to any clearly identified group of accounts, the gross proceeds … are not required to be reported to the extent that such gross proceeds … are reported by the reporting financial institution under the CARF

options: CRS 下唔使報，除非 RFI 選擇就某組清楚界定嘅帳戶照報
items.explain: 防止重複申報（IRD Bill 頁亦有說明）。

items.title: 2028 年起，investment entity 屬 legal arrangement（例如信託）時，equity interest holder 要報咩新資料？
items.short: 佢成為 equity interest holder 嘅角色
items.detail: 例如 settlor、受託人、protector、受益人。

quotes.text: for an equity interest held in an investment entity that is a legal arrangement—the role by virtue of which the reportable person is an equity interest holder

options: 佢成為 equity interest holder 嘅角色
items.explain: 例如 settlor、受託人、protector、受益人。

items.title: s.50F(2)(d) 2028 年起要加報咩？
items.short: 帳戶類型，以及屬 pre-existing 定 new account

options: 帳戶類型，以及屬 pre-existing 定 new account

quotes.text: Ord 8 s.21(1): Section 50G(1)(a)(ii), after “reportable account”— Add “and whenever the institution is required to update the information relating to the pre-existing account pursuant to domestic AML/KYC procedures”.

options: s.50G(1)(a)(ii)：每當本地 AML/KYC 程序要求更新該帳戶資料時

items.title: 2028 年後，客戶開新帳戶時因特殊情況未能及時取得同核實 self-cert。RFI 點做？
items.short: 先對該新帳戶用 pre-existing account 嘅盡職審查程序
items.detail: 只係特殊情況，唔可以當標準程序（s.2A(3)）。

quotes.text: … the institution must apply the due diligence procedures for pre- existing accounts to the new account until such self- certification is obtained and validated … (2) … the account … is to be reported as a new account

options: 先對該新帳戶用 pre-existing account 嘅盡職審查程序，直至取得 self-cert，但申報時仍當 new account
items.explain: 只係特殊情況，唔可以當標準程序（s.2A(3)）。

items.title: 揾錯處：「Sch 17D Part 7 s.2A 容許我哋一般先開戶，之後再補 self-cert。」

options: 錯：條文講明唔係標準程序，亦唔可以代替取得有效 self-cert 嘅要求

items.title: 客戶係香港同 A 國雙重居民，按稅務協定 tiebreaker 屬香港居民，佢只想申報香港。2028 年起點處理？
items.short: 唔可以用 tiebreaker，要申報兩個居民地
items.detail: 新 Sch 17D Part 7 s.2B。

options: 唔可以用 tiebreaker，要申報兩個居民地
items.explain: 新 Sch 17D Part 7 s.2B。

items.title: 2028 年起，change of circumstances 明確包括咩？
items.short: 任何影響持有人身份嘅資料新增或改變

options: 任何影響持有人身份嘅資料新增或改變，包括新增、替換或更改帳戶持有人，同埋按帳戶合併規則相關聯帳戶嘅改變
items.explain: 留意 IRD Common Issues：同一稅區內轉地址唔影響申報身份。

items.title: 一間 RFI 法律上唔需要用符合 FATF 嘅 AML/KYC 程序。佢點樣判斷新實體帳戶嘅 controlling persons？

items.detail: 同 CARF Sch 17EA Part 4 s.4(2) 一致。

quotes.text: If the institution is not legally required to apply AML/KYC procedures that are consistent with the FATF Recommendations, it must apply substantially similar procedures for the purpose of determining the controlling persons.

options: 要用實質相若嘅程序（Sch 17D Part 6 s.5(2)）
items.explain: 同 CARF Sch 17EA Part 4 s.4(2) 一致。

items.title: 2028 年起，RFI 修訂 AML/KYC 程序後收集到新資料，要點用？
items.short: 必須用嚟判斷有冇 change of circumstances

options: 必須用嚟判斷有冇 change of circumstances

items.title: 2028 年後，self-cert 冇 TIN，而 OECD 資料顯示嗰個稅區向所有居民發 TIN。RFI 可唔可以依賴？
items.short: 唔可以：屬知道或有理由知道不可靠嘅明示情況
items.detail: 新 Sch 17D Part 7 s.2(b)。

quotes.text: the self-certification does not contain a TIN and the information disseminated by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development indicates that the reportable jurisdiction issues TINs to all residents for tax purposes

options: 唔可以：屬知道或有理由知道不可靠嘅明示情況
items.explain: 新 Sch 17D Part 7 s.2(b)。

items.title: 一個 e-money 帳戶純粹因為 2023-CRS amendments 先成為 financial account，喺 2027 年 9 月開立。佢屬 pre-existing 定 new account？

options: Sch 17E 對應年份同 2029 年之中較遲者
items.explain: 所以首份含 CRS 2.0 資料嘅報表喺 2029 年。

items.title: Ord 8 Division 3（雜項修訂，例如 investment entity 定義由「trading」改「dealing」）幾時生效？
items.short: 刊憲當日（2026 年 11 月 13 日）
items.detail: s.1(2) 係一般規則；Division 3 唔喺 s.1(3) 至 (5) 範圍內。

options: 刊憲當日（2026 年 11 月 13 日），因為 s.1(3) 至 (5) 冇另訂日期

items.title: 按 IRD 新聞稿，香港幾時開始按 amended CRS 交換資料？

items.explain: 諮詢文件計劃 2029 年 9 月；新聞稿只講「starting from 2029」。

items.title: 一間現有 RFI 從未開 AEOI Account。Ord 4 生效後最遲幾時要登記？

items.title: 一個基金喺 2027 年 6 月先成為 RFI。登記限期係？

quotes.text: on or before the later of the following dates— (i) 31 March 2027; (ii) 31 January of the year following the calendar year in which the financial institution first becomes a reporting financial institution

items.title: 揾錯處：「IRD FAQ Q21 講冇 reportable account 嘅 RFI 唔使開 AEOI Account，所以 2027 年後我哋都唔使登記。」
items.short: 錯：Ord 4 新 s.50AB 由 2027 年 1 月 1 日起要求所有 …
items.detail: FAQ Q21 反映舊制（「No. If you do not maintain any reportable account, you are not required to register an AEOI Account.」）。

items.title: 一個 sub-fund 已經喺 umbrella fund 嘅 AEOI 帳戶下登記，所有 CRS 資料（包括 nil reporting）都由 umbrella fund 申報。Sub-fund 要唔要另外登記？
items.detail: Trustee 同佢嘅 trusts 都一樣。

quotes.text: … if an RFI (e.g. a trust, a sub-fund) has been registered under the account of another RFI … and the relevant CRS data, including nil reporting, is reported by the latter RFI, the RFI … is not required to make the registration separately.

options: 要另外開 AEOI Account 再取消
items.explain: Trustee 同佢嘅 trusts 都一樣。

items.title: RFI 委託 service provider 登記，SP 冇做。除咗 RFI 本身，SP 有冇刑責？
items.detail: RFI 本身亦唔可以話聘咗 SP 就有合理辯解（s.82C(2)）。

quotes.text: A person who is a service provider engaged to carry out a reporting financial institution’s obligations under section 50AB(1) commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse, fails to cause the institution to be registered as required by that section.

items.explain: RFI 本身亦唔可以話聘咗 SP 就有合理辯解（s.82C(2)）。

items.title: Ord 4 生效後，RFI 為報表保存嘅紀錄要保存幾耐？
items.detail: 盡職審查證據就係相關公曆年後 6 年；如涉及報表，就用 s.50D(2) 期間（s.50B(1)(a)(iii)）。

quotes.text: the specified record keeping period is a period of 6 years immediately after the date by which the return is required to be furnished under section 50C(1)

items.explain: 盡職審查證據就係相關公曆年後 6 年；如涉及報表，就用 s.50D(2) 期間（s.50B(1)(a)(iii)）。

items.title: 一間實體停止做 RFI，之後又搬咗辦公室。佢要做咩？

quotes.text: (a) if the entity changes its address—the entity must notify the Commissioner of its new address within 1 month after the change; and (b) the entity must ensure that the requirement under subsection (1) is complied with despite the cessation

options: 停止後 1 個月內通知；之後搬遷亦要 1 個月內通知新地址，並繼續保存紀錄

items.short: 董事作為 specified officer 犯 s.80CB 罪行
items.detail: 冇董事嘅話，就係受託人或負責管理嘅人（s.50D(8)）。

options: 董事作為 specified officer 犯 s.80CB 罪行：第 3 級罰款，法庭可命令補做
items.explain: 冇董事嘅話，就係受託人或負責管理嘅人（s.50D(8)）。

items.title: Assessor 想向一間已停止做 RFI 嘅實體索取資料，核實佢以前報表是否準確完整。邊條？
items.detail: 要喺通知指明嘅期限內、按指明方式遵從（s.50D(12)）。

quotes.text: An assessor may give a notice to a reporting financial institution, an entity that was a reporting financial institution or a specified officer requiring … to provide information for the purpose of ascertaining whether any information in a return … is accurate and complete.

items.explain: 要喺通知指明嘅期限內、按指明方式遵從（s.50D(12)）。

items.title: 一間公司 2027 年解散，解散前 6 年內曾經係 RFI。按 IRD 更新後嘅 Ord 4 頁，邊個要確保紀錄保存規定喺解散後繼續遵從？
items.detail: Specified officer 係解散前嘅每位董事；冇董事嘅話，就係每位受託人或負責管理嘅人。佢哋可以由 designated officer 代為承擔。呢個係 Ord 8 Part 3 對 Ord 4 嘅修訂。

quotes.text: IRD Ord 4 頁：“If an entity is dissolved and, at any time during the six years before its dissolution, it was an RFI, every specified officer … or the designated officer … (if any) of the entity must ensure that the relevant record keeping requirement is complied with despite the dissolution.”

options: 冇人，解散咗就唔使再保存
每位 specified officer，或者 designated officer（如有）
只係 IRD 自己保存
items.explain: Specified officer 係解散前嘅每位董事；冇董事嘅話，就係每位受託人或負責管理嘅人。佢哋可以由 designated officer 代為承擔。呢個係 Ord 8 Part 3 對 Ord 4 嘅修訂。

items.title: 按 IRD 嘅 Ord 4 頁，已解散 RFI 嘅 designated officer 可以係邊個？

items.detail: IRD 頁面喺括號入面解釋咗 designated officer 嘅範圍。

quotes.text: IRD Ord 4 頁：“the designated officer (i.e. one of the specified officers or a person who performed managerial functions in relation to the entity) (if any)”

options: 其中一位 specified officer，或者曾經對該實體履行管理職能嘅人
items.explain: IRD 頁面喺括號入面解釋咗 designated officer 嘅範圍。

items.title: 揾錯處：同事話「Ord 4 下，RFI 解散後保存紀錄嘅責任只落喺董事身上；如果冇董事，就冇人負責。」錯喺邊？

解散後嘅保存責任已經取消
items.explain: IRD 頁面嘅 specified officer 定義已經涵蓋冇董事嘅情況，亦加入咗 designated officer（Ord 8 Part 3 修訂）。

items.title: Change in circumstances 令 self-cert 部分資料唔再可靠。成份 self-cert 係咪即刻全部作廢？

每三年全面重新收 self-cert

items.title: A 先生持有 passive NFE 公司 51% 股權，同時係高級管理人員。2028 年起 RFI 申報佢嘅 CP 角色點填？
items.detail: 法人 CP 層級：ownership interests → control through other means → senior managing official。

quotes.text: the Reporting Financial Institution must report according to the hierarchy of roles indicated in paragraph 133 of the Commentary to Section VIII (i.e. ownership interests, control through other means, senior managing official)
quotes.pin: OECD 2023 Pt II，Commentary on Section I ¶7bis（p.105）

quotes.text: The Reporting Financial Institution is only required to indicate that the Reportable Person is a Controlling Person by virtue of its ownership interests, as this role comes first in the hierarchy

items.title: 2028 年起，s.50F(2)(c) 要為每位屬 reportable person 嘅 controlling person 額外報邊兩樣？

whether a valid self-certification has been provided for each reportable person

items.explain:

items.title: 有效指定 designated officer 之後，specified officers 嘅責任點？

仍然同 designated officer 共同負責

items.title: 指定生效期間，designated officer 搬屋換電話。邊個要通知 IRD？幾耐內？

quotes.text: if a designation of a designated officer is in effect and there is any change in the contact details of the designated officer—the designated officer must give a notice of the change to the Commissioner within 1 month after the change

全體 specified officers，14 日內

items.title: 前董事被控冇確保紀錄保存。佢可以點樣證明有 reasonable excuse？

quotes.text: the person had reasonable grounds to believe, and did believe, that a competent and reliable person other than the person

解散正正係責任嘅起點。

items.title: RFI 冇合理理由相信報表資料真確，但都照交（唔係明知，亦唔係罔顧）。屬唔屬 s.80B(6) 嘅罪行？

items.explain:

items.title: RFI 嘅營運經理意圖詐騙，令 RFI 交出虛假報表。佢個人有冇刑責？

quotes.text: is concerned in the management of a reporting financial institution
A person commits an offence if the person, with intent to defraud, causes or allows the institution to

options: 有：s.80C(1A) 適用於參與管理 RFI 嘅人
冇，只有 RFI 有刑責

僱員同管理人員都可以有刑責。
items.explain:
✗ A：(1)(a)–(c) 包括僱員、受聘工作者、參與管理嘅人。
✓ B：Ord 4 新 s.80C(1)(c)、(1A)。
✗ C：僱員同管理人員都可以有刑責。

items.title: 已停止嘅前 RFI 冇合理辯解冇遵從 assessor 嘅 s.50D(12) 資料要求，被定罪。法庭可以點？
items.short: 第 3 級＋法庭命令；違令第 4 級

An entity commits an offence if the entity does not comply with an order of the court under subsection (2), and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 4.

options: 第 3 級罰款，並可命令佢限期做該行為；唔遵從命令再犯第 4 級
items.explain:
✗ A：唔係。
✓ B：Ord 4 新 s.80CA(2)、(3)。
✗ C：有罰款。

items.title: IRD 已經就同一事實對 RFI 提出 s.80B 檢控。仲可唔可以再用 s.82C 金錢罰則？
items.detail: 反過嚟，已被評定 s.82C 罰則就唔會再就同一作為被控 s.80B（s.82C(9)）。

quotes.text: no prosecution for an offence under section 80B has been instituted in respect of the same facts
is not liable to be charged with an offence under section 80B for the same act or omission

options: 唔可以：s.82C(1)(b) 要冇就同一事實提出檢控
可以，只要金額低過罰款
items.explain:
反過嚟，已被評定 s.82C 罰則就唔會再就同一作為被控 s.80B（s.82C(9)）。
✓ A：Ord 4 新 s.82C(1)(b)。
✗ B：條文避免雙重處罰。
✗ C：前提係冇檢控。

items.title: s.82C 金錢罰則上限係幾多？
items.short: 唔超過 s.80B 嘅罰款

quotes.text: not exceeding the amount that the institution would have been liable to pay as a fine on conviction under section 80B

options: 唔超過 RFI 若被定罪 s.80B 要付嘅罰款
items.explain:

✓ C：Ord 4 新 s.82C(1)。

items.title: 邊個可以作出 s.82C 金錢罰則評定？

options: Commissioner 本人或副局長本人

items.explain:

✗ B：係行政罰則，唔係法庭判。
✓ C：Ord 4 新 s.82C(3)。

items.title: IRD 發出擬評定金錢罰則通知。RFI 交申述嘅限期最早可以係幾時？
items.detail: IRD 亦必須考慮 RFI 提交嘅申述同證據（s.82C(4)(b)）。

consider and take into account any representation and evidence submitted by the institution under paragraph (a)(ii)

✗ C：(5) 係例外。

1 month after the notice of assessment is given to the institution

quotes.pin: OECD 2023 Pt II，Commentary on Section VIII ¶10ter

quotes.text: all remuneration for the relevant activities of an entity is to be taken into account, regardless of whether that remuneration is paid directly to the entity or paid to another entity

options: 受託人冇收錢，所以唔係 FI
只計受託人自己帳戶收到嘅錢
付俾律師行嘅受託服務報酬都要計入

條文話唔論付俾邊個實體。
items.explain:

✗ B：條文話唔論付俾邊個實體。
✓ C：OECD ¶10ter；香港新 s.50A(14A)。

條文明確包括付俾其他實體。

✓ B：新 s.50A(14A)；OECD ¶10ter 亦提到託管費付俾其他實體嘅情況。
✗ C：條文明確包括付俾其他實體。

items.title: 保險經紀唔代客戶持有財務資產。佢係咪 custodial institution？

items.explain:
✗ A：睇有冇代持財務資產。

items.title: 一間科技公司只係為客戶提供 private key 儲存同保安服務，冇能力代客戶管理、買賣或轉讓資產。佢係咪 custodial institution？

options: 係，因為佢保管 private keys
option_explains: OECD ¶11bis：單純提供 private key 儲存或保安服務唔算。
要有能力代客戶管理、買賣或轉讓先算。

✓ B：OECD ¶11bis：單純提供 private key 儲存或保安服務唔算。
✗ C：要有能力代客戶管理、買賣或轉讓先算。

會：投資建議就係投資活動
items.explain:

✗ B：OECD 明確排除。

冇客戶，所以唔係 investment entity
只有經理人係 investment entity
option_explains: OECD 專門處理呢個問題。
items.explain:
✓ A：OECD ¶16。
✗ B：OECD 專門處理呢個問題。
✗ C：CIV 本身都可以係。

items.title: 家族投資公司請外部投資顧問，但顧問冇酌情權管理資產，只係提建議。家族公司係咪「managed by」FI？

items.title: 以下邊類 active NFE，就算符合 investment entity 定義，都唔算 investment entity？

✓ C：OECD ¶19（D(9)(d)–(g)）。

quotes.text: However, the term “Financial Asset” does not include a non-debt, direct interest in real property; or a commodity that is a physical good, such as wheat.

quotes.text: However, the term “Financial Asset” does not include a non-debt, direct interest in real property; or a commodity that is a physical good, such as wheat.

A notice under subsection (5) and a specification under subsection (9) are not subsidiary legislation.

quotes.text: An assessor may give a notice in writing to an HKRCASP requiring the HKRCASP to furnish a return reporting the information referred to in subsection (4) (required information) for the period specified in the notice (specified information period), which must be— (a) the calendar year preceding the year in which the notice is given; or (b) such other period as the Commissioner considers appropriate.
The return under subsection (1) must— (a) contain the required information; and (b) be furnished— (i) within the time specified in the notice; and (ii) in compliance with section 50V(2).

items.title: 實體 user 嘅 CP 喺 2027 年 9 月 1 日變咗（HKRCASP 當日知道）。到 2027 年 12 月 15 日仍然冇新 self-cert，亦冇確認原 self-cert 有效。HKRCASP 而家點處理？
items.short: 當 user／CP 係原 self-cert 嘅居民地，加上因情況改變可能成為…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.6(5)：知道 change of circumstances 嗰日起 self-cert 失效，最多可以沿用原身份 90 個曆日（或確認有效／取得新 self-cert 之日，以最早者為準）。s.6(6)：90 日內都攞唔到，就要當佢係原 self-cert 居民地同因改變可能成為居民嘅地方嘅稅務居民。9 月 1 日加 90 日係 11 月 30 日。

quotes.text: the HKRCASP may choose to treat the user or controlling person as having the same status that the user or controlling person had prior to the change of circumstances until the earliest of the following— (a) the expiry of a period of 90 calendar days from the date on which the self-certification became invalid under this subsection;

the HKRCASP must treat the entity crypto-asset user or controlling person as a resident for tax purposes in— (a) the jurisdiction or jurisdictions in which the user or controlling person claimed to be a resident for tax purposes in the original self- certification; and (b) the jurisdiction or jurisdictions in which the user or controlling person may be a resident for tax purposes as a result of the change of circumstances.

options: 繼續沿用舊身份到年尾
當 user／CP 係原 self-cert 嘅居民地，加上因情況改變可能成為居民嘅地方

items.title: 實體 user 嘅 self-cert 有一個無關重要嘅錯（inconsequential error）。HKRCASP 幾時可以當佢有效？
items.short: 檔案有足夠而且確鑿（conclusive）嘅文件，補足因錯漏而缺少嘅資料
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.7（Curing self-certification errors）：self-cert 有無關重要嘅錯，如果 HKRCASP 檔案有足夠文件補足缺少嘅資料，而且文件係確鑿嘅，就可以當 self-cert 有效。

quotes.text: An HKRCASP may treat a self-certification that contains an inconsequential error as valid if the HKRCASP has sufficient documentation on file to supplement the information missing from the self-certification owing to the error, in which case the documentation must be conclusive.

options: 檔案有足夠而且確鑿（conclusive）嘅文件，補足因錯漏而缺少嘅資料

items.title: Assessor 發 s.50S(11) 通知，要求 HKRCASP 提供資料。呢類通知可以為咗查咩？
items.short: 確定 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50N nexus，或者佢 s.50Q(1) 報…
items.detail: s.50S(11)：assessor 可以向 HKRCASP、曾經係 HKRCASP 嘅人、specified officer 或 designated officer 發通知，要求提供資料，以確定 HKRCASP 嘅 s.50N nexus，或者 s.50Q(1) 報表資料是否準確完整。s.50S(12)：要喺通知指明期間內、按指明方式同形式遵守。

quotes.text: An assessor may give a notice to an HKRCASP, an individual or entity that was an HKRCASP, a specified officer or a designated officer (if any) requiring the HKRCASP, the individual or entity or the officer concerned (as the case may be) to provide information for the purposes of ascertaining— (a) the nexus of the HKRCASP under any provision of section 50N; or (b) whether any information in a return furnished under section 50Q(1) by the HKRCASP is accurate and complete.
must comply with a notice under subsection (11)— (a) within the period specified in the notice; and (b) by the means and in the form (if any) specified in the notice.

option_explains: 錯：s.50S(11) 針對 CARF nexus 同報表準確性。
錯：對象包括現時同以前嘅 HKRCASP、specified officer 同 designated officer。
options: 只可以查 HKRCASP 嘅利得稅

items.title: 一間交易平台為客戶進行 crypto 兌換。佢會唔會單憑呢項服務，就屬 investment entity 定義 (d)(iii) 嘅「otherwise investing in, administering, or managing…」？
items.short: 唔會：s.50M(10)(c) 講明呢句唔包括為客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務
items.detail: s.50M(10)(c)：investment entity 定義 (d)(iii)「otherwise investing in, administering, or managing financial assets, money or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entities or individuals」唔包括為客戶或代客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務。即係純粹做兌換嘅 RCASP，唔會單憑呢點變成 investment entity。

quotes.text: the words “otherwise investing in, administering, or managing financial assets, money or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entities or individuals” do not include the provision of service of effectuating exchange transactions for or on behalf of customers;

option_explains: 錯：牌照係 (a)、(b) 嘅問題，唔係 (d)(iii)。
options: 會，兌換服務就係代客管理 crypto
唔會：s.50M(10)(c) 講明呢句唔包括為客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務
要睇佢有冇證監會牌照
items.explain: s.50M(10)(c)：investment entity 定義 (d)(iii)「otherwise investing in, administering, or managing financial assets, money or relevant crypto-assets on behalf of other entities or individuals」唔包括為客戶或代客戶進行兌換交易嘅服務。即係純粹做兌換嘅 RCASP，唔會單憑呢點變成 investment entity。

items.title: 實體 user 係一個由持牌資產管理公司管理、收入主要嚟自買賣 crypto 嘅基金（investment entity 定義 (e)）。佢係咪 excluded person？
items.short: 唔係：(e) 類 investment entity 唔屬 excluded …
items.detail: s.50M(1) excluded person (f)：financial institution 係 excluded person，但 investment entity 定義 (e)（由 FI 管理、總收入主要來自投資或買賣金融資產或 relevant crypto-assets 嘅實體）除外。呢類實體唔係 active entity，就要按 Sch 17EA Pt 4 判斷佢本身同 CP。

quotes.text: an entity the stock of which is regularly traded on one or more established securities markets; (b) an entity that is a related entity of an entity described in paragraph (a); (c) a governmental entity; (d) an international organization; (e) a central bank; or (f) a financial institution other than an entity described in paragraph (e) of the definition of investment entity in this subsection;

an entity— (i) that is managed by a custodial institution, a depository institution, a specified insurance company, or an entity mentioned in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d); and (ii) whose gross income is primarily attributable to investing, reinvesting, or trading in financial assets or relevant crypto-assets,

option_explains: 錯：s.50M(1) excluded person (f) 排除 (e) 類 investment entity。
錯：受管理正正係 (e) 類，唔屬 excluded person。
options: 係，所有 financial institution 都係 excluded person
唔係：(e) 類 investment entity 唔屬 excluded person，所以可能係 reportable user，亦可能要睇 CP
係，因為佢有持牌公司管理

items.title: 揾錯處：「公司網站寫明佢係貿易公司，所以我哋唔使攞 self-cert 都可以判定佢係 active entity，唔使識別 CP。」
items.short: 錯：要根據 user 提供嘅 self-cert 判定佢係 active en…
items.detail: Sch 17EA Pt 4 s.3：對 excluded person 以外嘅實體 user，HKRCASP 要判斷佢有冇屬 reportable person 嘅 CP，除非「on the basis of a self-certification provided by the user」判定佢係 active entity。網站資料可以用嚟確認合理，但唔可以代替 self-cert。

quotes.text: an HKRCASP must determine whether the user has one or more controlling persons who are reportable persons unless the HKRCASP determines that the user is an active entity on the basis of a self- certification provided by the user.

option_explains: 錯：Pt 4 s.3 要根據 user 提供嘅 self-cert 判定 active entity。
錯：excluded person 同（按 self-cert）active entity 唔使。
options: 錯：要根據 user 提供嘅 self-cert 判定佢係 active entity，先可以唔使判斷 CP
